# @bankkroll/tesdk

> Universal TypeScript SDK for the Tesla Fleet API — runs on Node, browsers, and edge runtimes. 122 typed methods across
> 10 namespaces, zero runtime dependencies, MIT licensed.

Every page below is available as Markdown. Fetch these instead of the rendered
HTML: they carry the same content without the markup.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://bankkroll.github.io/tesdk/md/index.md): Universal TypeScript SDK for the Tesla Fleet API — runs on Node, browsers, and edge runtimes.
- [Quickstart](https://bankkroll.github.io/tesdk/md/quickstart.md): From an empty project to reading live vehicle data.
- [Authentication](https://bankkroll.github.io/tesdk/md/auth.md): Three token types, each for a different relationship between your application
- [Guides](https://bankkroll.github.io/tesdk/md/guides.md): The parts of the Fleet API that surprise people, and how this SDK models them.
- [Errors](https://bankkroll.github.io/tesdk/md/errors.md): Every failure is a `TeslaError` subclass, discriminable by class or by a stable `code`.
- [API reference](https://bankkroll.github.io/tesdk/md/api.md): Generated from the shipped type declarations, so it always matches the
- [Types](https://bankkroll.github.io/tesdk/md/types.md): 77 interfaces and 9 type aliases exported from `@bankkroll/tesdk`.
- [Examples](https://bankkroll.github.io/tesdk/md/examples.md): Four runnable applications and 45 focused snippets, all typechecked in CI

## API reference

- [client.vehicles](https://bankkroll.github.io/tesdk/md/api-vehicles.md): Listing, live data, wake handling, drivers, and share invites.
- [client.commands](https://bankkroll.github.io/tesdk/md/api-commands.md): Every actuating command, from locks to navigation.
- [client.energy](https://bankkroll.github.io/tesdk/md/api-energy.md): Powerwall, Solar, and Wall Connector sites.
- [client.charging](https://bankkroll.github.io/tesdk/md/api-charging.md): Charging history, sessions, and PDF invoices.
- [client.telemetry](https://bankkroll.github.io/tesdk/md/api-telemetry.md): Fleet Telemetry streaming configuration.
- [client.partner](https://bankkroll.github.io/tesdk/md/api-partner.md): Partner registration and telemetry diagnostics.
- [client.fleet](https://bankkroll.github.io/tesdk/md/api-fleet.md): Specs, options, pricing, warranty, and eligibility.
- [client.user](https://bankkroll.github.io/tesdk/md/api-user.md): Account profile, region discovery, and orders.
- [client.ocpi](https://bankkroll.github.io/tesdk/md/api-ocpi.md): Tesla Charging API locations and tariffs (OCPI 2.2.1).
- [client.oauth](https://bankkroll.github.io/tesdk/md/api-oauth.md): Token flows and credential lifecycle.
